what: Timing of the unchanged perception function (hci.vision_center.reading) on the three stored fixture frames, twice each, after the budget gate had blocked stage B1. No simulator, no scene, no outcome. Run on the rented server before it was deleted, and on the development machine.

server.cpu: AMD EPYC 7742, 256 logical CPUs visible in the container (shared host, load average 49 at the time)

audit_measurement.note: in the audit the time of one reading includes the camera render and, in the acting scene, the control steps

reading: With the default thread count the numerical library starts one thread per visible CPU on a loaded shared host and single readings take up to 24 s; with 1 or 8 threads the same code takes 0.2-2.6 s. The slow reading is an execution-environment effect, not a property of the estimator. This was measured after the gate; the gate was not re-run.
